Keep in Touch
Stay in touch with us by following us on Twitter, becoming our friend on Facebook, or subscribing to one of our RSS Feeds.
Preble County emergency preparedness exercise planned Oct. 17
The Preble County Local Emergency Planning Committee, in collaboration with DuPont and Kettering Health Preble, will conduct a mandated Environmental Protection Agency preparedness exercise on Saturday morning, Oct. 17. Read on...
Commissioners recognize September as National Preparedness Month
The Preble County Board of Commissioners has proclaimed September as National Preparedness Month, encouraging residents, businesses and community organizations to take steps now to prepare for potential emergencies and disasters. Read on...
Preble County Commission proclaims September Suicide Prevention Awareness Month
The Preble County Commissioners proclaimed September 2026 as Suicide Prevention Awareness Month in Preble County, calling on residents and community organizations to support efforts to reduce stigma, increase awareness and help prevent suicide. Read on...
Commissioners proclaim August Child Support Awareness Month
The Preble County Board of Commissioners has proclaimed August 2026 as Child Support Awareness Month in Preble County, recognizing the role child support services play in strengthening families and supporting children. Read on...
Commissioners proclaim August Emergency Management Awareness Month
The Preble County Board of Commissioners has proclaimed August 2026 as Emergency Management Awareness Month in Preble County, recognizing the professionals who work behind the scenes to help prepare communities for emergencies and coordinate responses... Read on...
Commissioners proclaim National Public Safety Telecommunicators Week
Preble County Commissioners formally recognized the county’s emergency dispatch personnel during its Monday, April 13 meeting by proclaiming April 12-18 as National Public Safety Telecommunicators Week in Preble County. Read on...
HOPE Initiative Highlights Power of Positive Childhood Experiences
A new resource promoting Healthy Outcomes from Positive Experiences (HOPE) is being shared with families and caregivers to help support children’s resilience and well-being. Read on...
Hairston to support Infant & Early Childhood Mental Health
The Ohio Department of Children & Youth has introduced Kayla Hairston, IECMH, as the region’s designated Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health (IECMH) Consultant and Trainer. Read on...
